_comment: Models sold (almost) only as mild hybrids although listings show plain petrol/diesel. A hint never sets the powertrain; it only asks the client to check the COC. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions over model + version + title.

hints.note: Mercedes C-Class W206 (2021+): ISG 48V mild hybrid
Mercedes E-Class W214 (2023+): ISG 48V mild hybrid
Audi A4–A8 / Q5–Q8 (2019+): many versions MHEV 12V/48V
